responsibility: Implements low-level assembler emission helpers shared by GCC’s DWARF-related producers. This file owns routines that format and write target-correct integer data, symbol deltas, section-relative offsets, addresses, strings, and LEB128 values, including handling of assembler capabilities, endianness, relocation forms, and encoded exception-handling pointers. It also manages the pool of indirect constant references used for encoded addresses in read-only sections, so higher-level DWARF, CTF, and BTF emitters can serialize binary records without duplicating target-specific assembly details.
same_name_distinction: Contains the target-aware implementations of the assembler-emission helpers declared in dwarf2asm.h, including actual formatting of integers, deltas, relocatable addresses, LEB128 values, and the indirect-constant pool used by DWARF-related emitters.
